hooks.command: $d = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $d.tool_input.file_path; if ($f -match 'specification[\\/]') { Write-Output '{"decision": "block", "reason": "specification/ is read-only upstream reference"}' } else { Write-Output '{"decision": "approve"}' }

$d = $input | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = if ($d.tool_input.file_path) { $d.tool_input.file_path } elseif ($d.tool_response.filePath) { $d.tool_response.filePath } else { '' }; if ($f -match '\.cs$') { dotnet csharpier format $f 2>$null | Out-Null }
